intent: PSI-018: Build Admin Users page (/dashboard/admin/users) and admin-users Edge Function.
summary: Added migration 20260925234449_admin_list_users.sql, implemented Deno Edge Function supabase/functions/admin-users/index.ts for user invites and suspension, created Server Actions in features/admin/actions.ts for listing users and editing memberships, and built the Users management view with search, role badges, single invite dialog, CSV bulk import, and edit dialogs. Verified with tsc, oxlint, next build, and pgTAP test suite.

changes.note: Exposes admin_list_users() RPC helper for user directory
Shared CORS and JSON helper for Edge Functions
Deno Edge Function handling user invites and suspensions
Type definitions for admin users, roles, and groups
Server Actions for fetching users, invites, and membership updates
Interactive users table with status and role badges
User roles and groups editor modal

decisions.decision: Use admin_list_users() for querying auth user metadata
decisions.reason: PostgREST cannot directly query auth.users; security-definer helper exposes only safe metadata guarded by permissions.

decisions.decision: Perform role and group assignments via Server Actions
decisions.reason: Direct user role updates run as the authenticated user, allowing RLS to enforce no-escalation rules and last-admin triggers.

verification.manual: Verified /dashboard/admin/users page builds cleanly and renders.

human_review.reason: Awaiting human operator review stamp on PSI-018 card.
